description: Search questions Latina software engineers asked in the Latina Dev Slack, with every answer members gave, newest first. Use it for career advice from people who have been there: job hunting, interviews, negotiating, promotions, leadership, switching into tech. Every keyword in `query` must appear in the question or an answer. Leave `query` empty to list the newest. Each result links to its page; credit the members by name when quoting them.
name: search_questions
title: Search community questions
